growth.summary: Baxter initiated a one-year moratorium on new hyperscale AI data centers in unincorporated Palm Beach County, which the commission gave final unanimous approval on Sept. 24, 2026. The measure adds a definition of large-scale data centers to the county land-development code and pauses new facilities with a peak electrical load of at least 50 megawatts.
growth.quote: This temporary moratorium will allow sufficient time to evaluate the potential impact of these facilities.

record.item: A whistleblower complaint by a former county staffer, filed shortly before the Aug. 18 primary and now under investigation by the Palm Beach County Commission on Ethics, alleges Baxter pressured the staffer to pursue a relationship with a wealthy donor. Baxter denies it ('Never have, never would, and it goes against everything I believe in') and has called it a political smear she attributes to her opponent's camp.

record.item: Voted with a unanimous commission on Sept. 24, 2026 for final approval of a one-year moratorium on new hyperscale AI data centers in unincorporated Palm Beach County; she brought the proposal forward. In an election-spotlight interview four days later she described her approach as a zoning question, saying data centers should be reclassified from light to heavy industrial.
